seoTitle: Hreflang Matrix Builder: CSV to Tags, Headers or Sitemap
metaDescription: Build hreflang for many pages from a CSV with one row per page and one column per locale. Output as link tags, headers or a sitemap.
intro: Turns a spreadsheet of page versions into complete hreflang sets, in the format you choose, with an optional x-default taken from one column.
why:
On a large site you keep translations in a spreadsheet: each row a page, each column a locale. This tool takes that table as CSV, checks the column codes, requires absolute URLs and builds the full set for every version. A row with a blank cell simply omits that version.

Choose which column should double as x-default, or leave it empty. The sitemap output has one url element per version, each with every alternate, as Google describes.
howTo: Paste or type the CSV with locale codes in the header row.
Choose the format and the x-default column.
Read the notes for bad codes or short rows.

faq.q: Can a page exist in only some locales?
faq.a: Yes, leave the cell blank. Rows with fewer than two versions are skipped.
Comma, semicolon or tab, detected from the header line.
Only what your browser can handle; large sitemaps should be split.

faq.q: Does it check the pages exist?
faq.a: No, it cannot fetch them. Use the CSV audit with crawl data for that.
